python: stdlib only; no numpy installs, scientific packages, data/model inputs or numerical execution outside tiny invented controls
input_format: JSON-compatible Python values; unknown/malformed fields rejected by dispatch; all finite scalar arrays except semantically documented missing metrics are explicit errors
dispatch_API: evaluate(kind: str, payload: dict) -> dict; deterministic pure source numerical primitives with finite checks, not clinical/scientific qualification

payload: groups: dict[str,list[int]], disjoint cover of columns
phase_period: positive float only when circular columns; otherwise null
behavior.output: per_dimension_r2 list; groups dict of unweighted dimension mean; circular metric use minimal signed modular residual and circular mean resultant; degenerate SST or resultant => explicit ValueError, never silently skip; this is named prospective benchmark convention, not native historical Cycle parity

payload: spikes: rows x neurons, nonnegative integers
rates: same shape, strictly positive spikes/second
neural_state.output: bits_per_spike = sum(spikes*log(rate/mean_rate) - bin_seconds*(rate-mean_rate))/(log(2)*sum(spikes)); no total spikes => error. Original NLB historical evaluator remains separately gated.

psth.output: per-neuron R2 and mean; this compares already authenticated operator-constructed PSTHs, not public test targets

payload: comparison_states: equal row count finite matrix, independent dimensionality
block_size: positive integer metadata upper bound
geometry.output: stream all unique unordered point pairs, Euclidean distances normalized separately by own pairwise mean; return count, pairwise mean distances, Pearson of paired distances, mean absolute normalized-distance discrepancy; optional unknown histogram edges never invented; no dense pair matrix

nearest_library.output: nearest Euclidean distance each state, normalized by mean unique library-pair distance; no covariance Gaussian generator inferred

contrasts.output: signed_gain vector, mean_gain, mean_absolute_difference, worst_gain; no seed/sample statistical independence claim

payload: counts: exact sorted positive integer vector
scores: each count x fixed repetitions, finite
neuron_loss_curve.output: per-count mean and sample SD with n>=2; linear interpolation to1..max only when endpoints present; threshold crossing summaries explicitly defined in docs; never label interpolated points measured

payload: attempts: nonempty list of exact rows {id,role,status,wall_seconds,cpu_seconds,gpu_seconds,token_count,bytes_written,peak_rss_bytes}
cost.output: sums of all attempts including failures and peak RSS; ids unique, counts nonnegative ints (bool rejected), times finite nonnegative; no success-only filtering

scope: Bank numerical operations form shared assessment ingredients for all17scope modules; original per-module support/config/native/simulation/evaluator definitions require owner admission mapping. Do not implement invented missing source policies.
tests: Independent meaningful tiny controls with preserved failure/cost evidence; pin source before controls; no helper; no Git; cap individual invented data to a few KiB and report conservative cumulative/retained/live envelopes.
